result.brief: 利用 SIGReg 正则化诱导的高斯潜空间结构，拟合状态动力学矩阵并以其特征基裁剪规划代价中的噪声子空间，实现无需重训的潜空间规划改进。
result.reason: Proposes a post-hoc latent-space projection for planning cost in latent world models, analyzing latent uncertainty structure from SIGReg regularization; contributes to latent representation/world model usage.
